show-embedded.description: Show hits inside archives and mailboxes
show-embedded.tooltip: Selecting such a hit opens the archive or mailbox that contains it.

icon-size.tooltip: Set this to the menu's "Application icon size".

show-badge.description: Mark file results with a search badge
show-badge.tooltip: Shows a small magnifier on the file icons, to tell file results apart from apps.

show-recoll-row.description: Show a "Search in Recoll" row above the file results
show-recoll-row.tooltip: Opens the Recoll window with the same search. Needs the 'recoll' package. If no app matches, the menu selects this row first, so Enter opens Recoll instead of the first file.

recoll-confdir.tooltip: Leave empty to use the default (~/.recoll, or $RECOLL_CONFDIR).
